limits: Instrumented timing is excluded from ordinary samples
Inclusive callback CPU can overlap; isolated totals omit overlaps and are not an additive exclusive breakdown
Callback component times and the isolated source experiment do not establish whole-command speedup
Older absolute profile CPU and final heap values at different boundaries are not causal before/after comparisons

memory_note: Dedicated scope memory.peak includes charged processes and file cache; not PHP heap or a sum of child maximum RSS values.
admission_criteria: Elapsed/CPU medians improve; at least six of eight paired elapsed and CPU rounds improve; median scope peak grows no more than 5 percent; candidate remains faster than both Larastan profiles; all 64 native suites, original-scanner state and exception controls, full diagnostic and sealed input checks pass
